lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Are you looking for a job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我想在大公司工作。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ xiǎng zài dà gōngsī gōngzuò.
lines.english: Yes, I want to work at a big company.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我会说一点儿。我正在学习。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr. Wǒ zhèngzài xuéxí.
lines.english: I can speak a little. I am studying.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 会，我会用电脑。我也会写汉字。
lines.pinyin: Huì, wǒ huì yòng diànnǎo. Wǒ yě huì xiě Hànzì.
lines.english: Yes, I can use a computer. I can also write Chinese characters.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 很好！希望你找到好工作。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo! Xīwàng nǐ zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
lines.english: Very good! Hope you find a good job.
